content: Finally, I discard stimuli in which the focus verb or its plural/singular inflection does not appear as a single word in the BERT word-piece-based vocabulary (and hence cannot be predicted by the model). This include discarding BIBREF3 stimuli involving the words swims or admires, resulting in 23,368 discarded pairs (out of 152,300). I similarly discard 680 sentences from BIBREF1 where the focus verb or its inflection were one of 108 out-of-vocabulary tokens, and 28 sentence-pairs (8 tokens) from BIBREF2 .
